name: commit-draft
displayName: Commit Draft: AI Commit Messages for Codex & Claude
description: Draft Git commit messages with AI, using the Codex CLI or Claude Code you already use. Unofficial; not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs your installed Git and AI command-line tools.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Requires a local Git checkout and installed command-line tools.

commitDraft.provider.description: Installed CLI to use. It reuses that tool's existing sign-in.

commitDraft.codexPath.description: Codex executable name or absolute path, without arguments. On Windows use a native .exe, not a .cmd shim.

commitDraft.claudePath.description: Claude executable name or absolute path, without arguments. On Windows use a native .exe, not a .cmd shim.

commitDraft.codexModel.description: Optional Codex model. Empty uses the CLI's built-in default, without user config overrides.

commitDraft.claudeModel.description: Optional Claude model. Empty uses the CLI default.

commitDraft.conventionalCommits.description: Request Conventional Commits format, such as fix: or feat:.

commitDraft.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the selected AI tool.

commitDraft.maxDiffBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum diff size, in bytes, sent to the AI tool. Larger diffs are condensed to fit rather than rejected: every changed file is listed with its line counts, and long file patches are shortened. Lock files and minified files are summarized only. A full 256 KB prompt measured about 80,000 tokens with Codex and 150,000 with Claude; larger values cost more and must fit the model's context window.

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run clean && node scripts/build.mjs
